content.text:
A published book with no copies now shows `isAvailable: false`. `dotnet build` and `dotnet test` on `Library.slnx` both pass (7 tests).

The bug was in `src/Library/Domain/Book.cs`. The check was `Copies >= 0`, so a book with 0 copies still counted as available. I changed it to `Copies > 0`.

I added a regression test, `PublishedBookWithNoCopyIsNotAvailable`, in `LibraryApiTests.cs`. It creates two published books through the API. The one with 0 copies must read back as unavailable, and the one with 1 copy as available. I didn't run it against the old code, so I haven't seen it fail without the fix.

I added a regression test, `PublishedBookWithNoCopyIsNotAvailable`, in `LibraryApiTests.cs`. It creates two published books through the API.
